english.title: Unship / unload counterfeit notes / currency with intent to evade a prohibition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[unshipped counterfeit currency notes,]_
(B)_[unshipped counterfeit protected coins,]_
(C)_[landed counterfeit currency notes in a port,]_
(D)_[landed counterfeit protected coins in a port,]_
(E)_[unloaded counterfeit currency notes from an aircraft,]_
(F)_[unloaded counterfeit protected coins from an aircraft,]_
(G)_[assisted in the unshipping of counterfeit currency notes,]_
(H)_[assisted in the unshipping of counterfeit protected coins,]_
(I)_[assisted in the landing of counterfeit currency notes at a port,]_
(J)_[assisted in the landing of counterfeit protected coins at a port,]_
(K)_[assisted in the unloading of counterfeit currency notes from an aircraft,]_
(L)_[assisted in the unloading of counterfeit protected coins from an aircraft,]_

the importation of which was prohibited by section 20 of the Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981, with intent to evade the prohibition
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(2)(a), (4) and (5A)(c) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
unship / land in a port / unload from an aircraft OR
assist in such unshipping / landing / unloading of
counterfeit currency notes / protected coins
the importation of which was prohibited by an enactment
with intent to evade the prohibition

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
